title: CAffNet: Hard Constraint-Affine Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.24437v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a novel framework for embedding hard constraint satisfaction into neural network (NN) architectures, specifically feedforward neural networks and transformers, with input-dependent affine constraints of arbitrary cardinality. Traditional constraint enforcement approaches either rely on penalty-based soft constraints, which offer no guarantee of satisfaction, or on post-processing methods that enforce constraints after the NN is trained, which may lead to suboptimality. We introduce a trainable constraint-affine (CAffine) layer into NNs, yielding CAffNet, which goes beyond enforcing affine constraints via fixed orthogonal or parallel projections and enables joint optimization with network parameters. Moreover, we impose no restrictions on the constraint space dimensions and establish that our construction preserves the universal approximation properties of NNs, while providing provable guarantees on constraint adherence for

translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个新颖的框架，用于将硬约束满足嵌入到神经网络（NN）架构中，特别是前馈神经网络和Transformer，支持任意基数的依赖于输入的仿射约束。传统的约束执行方法要么依赖于基于惩罚的软约束（无法保证约束满足），要么依赖于在神经网络训练完成后执行约束的后处理方法（可能导致次优性）。我们在神经网络中引入了一个可训练的约束仿射（CAffine）层，形成了CAffNet，它超越了通过固定正交或平行投影来执行仿射约束的方式，并能够与网络参数进行联合优化。此外，我们对约束空间维度没有任何限制，并证明了我们的构造保留了神经网络的通用逼近性质，同时为约束遵守提供了可证明的保证。
tldr: 提出了CAffNet框架，通过引入可训练的约束仿射层将硬仿射约束满足直接嵌入神经网络架构中，实现约束与网络参数的联合优化，同时保留通用逼近性质并提供约束满足的可证明保证。
en_tdlr: CAffNet introduces a trainable constraint-affine layer that embeds hard affine constraint satisfaction directly into neural network architectures, enabling joint optimization with network parameters while preserving universal approximation properties and providing provable constraint adherence guarantees.
